MATCHING & SORTING · TODDLER 4 · AGE 2

Match Shape to Outline

Five solid shapes, five empty outlines — every shape fits one frame.

THE SHEET — SOLVE IT RIGHT ON IT

Your activity is ready.

Pick a color, then draw the matching lines, circle the twins or sort the groups straight on the picture with your finger, a stylus or the mouse. Press Save my work when you are proud — your drawing stays here for next time, and the picture is yours to keep.

← Object ColorsPrevious activityPuzzle Halves →Next activity
HOW TO DO IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Name a shape

    The blue square — say it, trace it with a finger.

  2. 2

    Find its outline

    Which empty shape on the other side would the square fit into?

  3. 3

    Draw the line

    Connect each solid shape to its outline.

Ask a grown-up to read the steps aloud the first time. After that, you know just what to do.

YOUR PENCIL CASE

Pick your tools.

Pencil, nine crayons, an eraser, undo, redo and clear — the tools appear right here and work on the picture. Save keeps your finished drawing and remembers it for next time.

MY PROGRESS

Save it to keep it.

This page is cleared for you the moment you save your finished drawing. Nothing counts until then — opening the page is just opening the door.

Cleared! Your drawing is saved on this device for your child, and the ribbon is on in Class 10. Come back any time — your drawing will be waiting.

FOR GROWN-UPS

What this page practises.

The outline is a “frame” — try fitting language: “does the star fit in this frame? No? Keep looking!” Puzzles do exactly this, which is why this page feels like play.

  • Shape recognition
  • Silhouette matching
  • Drawing lines
  • Shape words

This activity belongs to Class 10 — Matching and Sorting (Age 2) on the Learning Path, and the paper version lives with all thirty-one others in Matching & Sorting Worksheets. Progress is saved on this device for the child chosen in My Classroom — and only a real save of finished work marks it cleared, never just opening the page.
